title: Five Café Photos With Music
tests: Produces one finished five-photo reel with the requested sequence, smooth transitions and an audible instrumental soundtrack.

faults.what: The storefront and latte shots have large blurred padding bands with conspicuous horizontal boundaries, making the vertical framing look less polished.

judge.summary: The output is a roughly 10-second vertical café montage with no added text and a visible dissolve, though the blurred padding is conspicuous and some requirements cannot be fully verified.

must_haves.item: One playable vertical reel runs for approximately 10 seconds.
must_haves.why: The supplied MP4 has a reported duration of 10.1 seconds and portrait-format output frames.

must_haves.item: All five supplied café photos appear recognizably in the requested order.
must_haves.why: The samples show the storefront, latte, pastries dissolving into a barista, and then an interior, consistent with the requested sequence; however, the original barista and interior attachments are not shown for comparison.

must_haves.item: Each photo has enough screen time to be recognizable, rather than appearing only as a flash.
must_haves.why: The storefront, latte, and interior are clearly recognizable in their sampled frames, but the sparse sampling does not establish the individual hold times, especially for the pastries and barista.

must_haves.item: Relaxed instrumental music is audible, with no speech or singing.
must_haves.why: The audio report confirms sound and no clear speech, but does not establish whether it is relaxed instrumental music rather than ambience or whether singing is absent.

must_haves.item: Transitions between photos are smooth, and no added text appears.
must_haves.why: The sampled transition shows a conventional cross-dissolve between pastries and the barista, and no added text is visible in the output frames.
